label: Foundational beings are contingent at w, from existence-conditional essences (inference)
rule: No essential exclusion, then the essentialist account of possibility
meaning: Existence-conditional essentialism's verdict. For a foundational f, no essential truth entails its existence: one of f's own would hold at the representable point lacking f (conditional essences), and no other being's does (unrequired by others). So the essentialist account makes f absent at some accessible world. Esse = essence plays no role: on this account the identity is modally idle. Constructive.
